description: Generates an AI training program using team workouts. Use when the user wants to create a multi-week program from their workout library. Not for adapting an existing program (use adapt_plan). Goal IDs come from list_team_goals.

end_user_fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness level as a one-item list, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

end_user_goal_ids.description: Member's goal IDs from list_team_goals, e.g. ["63c92926f920a9005c4e619c"].

end_user_training_days_per_week.description: Days per week the member trains, 1 to 7.

goal_ids.description: Program goal IDs from list_team_goals, e.g. ["63c92926f920a9005c4e619c"].

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

max_weeks.description: Longest program length in weeks, 1 to 24.

min_weeks.description: Shortest program length in weeks, 1 to 24. If no min_weeks or max_weeks is set and goal_ids are given, 4 to 8 weeks is used.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

user_requirements.description: Free-text guidance for the AI, up to 2000 characters, e.g. "Low impact, no jumping, knee friendly".

name: generate_program
title: Generate program
